reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Digital sovereignty: master, not consume AI
themes.definition: AI framed through technological sovereignty: countries must master and adapt AI rather than merely consume it, as part of national sovereignty.
themes.inclusion: Include passages asserting digital/technological sovereignty over AI or rejecting mere consumption of foreign AI.
themes.exclusion: Exclude general access-gap statements without a sovereignty or control framing.
themes.boundary_cases: National AI centres created explicitly to promote sovereignty also fit AI_NATIONAL_STRATEGY.

examples.quote: We must not simply consume AI technology. We must master it, adapt it to our realities, and contribute to its development.
digital and technological sovereignty has become an essential dimension of national sovereignty

themes.label: Generative AI's opportunities and risks
themes.definition: AI acknowledged as offering enormous opportunities but also significant risks.
themes.inclusion: Include explicit framings of AI as both opportunity and risk.
themes.boundary_cases: Brief duality statements introducing sovereignty arguments still count.

examples.quote: AI offers enormous opportunities, and we acknowledge that, but also significant risks.

themes.label: Investing in AI skills and infrastructure
themes.definition: Need to invest in skills, research, innovation and infrastructure so youth can participate in AI transformation.
themes.inclusion: Include calls to invest in AI skills, research, or infrastructure.
themes.boundary_cases: If investment is framed as youth participation, also consider AI_YOUTH_EDUCATION.

examples.quote: We must invest in skills, in research, in innovation, and infrastructure so that young people can participate fully in this transformation.

themes.label: National AI and robotics centre
themes.definition: The country cites establishing a national AI institution.
themes.inclusion: Include references to national AI centres, strategies or investments.
themes.boundary_cases: Also code sovereignty when explicitly linked.

examples.quote: has established Mali's Center for Artificial Intelligence Robotics to promote our country's digital sovereignty

themes.label: Legal and ethical AI frameworks
themes.definition: Call to define appropriate legal and ethical frameworks for AI.
themes.inclusion: Include calls for legal/ethical frameworks for AI where not explicitly international.
themes.boundary_cases: Ambiguous-level frameworks are coded here and may also get AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE.

examples.quote: This requires defining and creating appropriate legal and ethical frameworks.

value.rationale: Mali's single passage frames AI within strategic and digital sovereignty, acknowledging opportunities and risks and stressing mastery, skills investment, ethical frameworks and a national AI centre.
